notes:
I found two real places in Ottawa and Gatineau that fit a preschooler. I could only read the venues' own pages for these two, and neither page covered September 4 to 6, 2027 (Saturday to Monday, which is Labour Day).

- **Canadian Children's Museum:** 
It sits inside the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, just minutes from downtown Ottawa.
 
General admission tickets cover both the Museum of History and the Children's Museum.
 
At busy times, entry to the Children's Museum is first-come, first-served.
 The page I read posted no price.
- **Canada Science and Technology Museum:** Ingenium's ticket page says 
admission is free every day from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.
 and that 
advance ticketing is strongly recommended.
 That page showed no regular hours or prices. One non-official visitor guide says the museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, but I could not tie that to Ingenium's own page. So confirm whether it is open on Monday, Sept. 6.

I also looked for the Canadian Museum of Nature. I only found ticket resellers and visitor guides, not its own page, so I left it out.
